correctness.rationale: Matrix-tree theorem gives τ=(product over bridges w_e) × sum over deleted cycle edge j of product_{i in C\j} w_i. Positive determinant and full budget hold; logdet is strictly concave since weighted reduced Laplacian is injective for simple graph. Euler homogeneity gives λ=(N-1)/B. Bridge KKT gives w_e=B/((N-1)c_e); a zero cycle edge is KKT optimal iff its cost ≥ sum others. Interior KKT gives x_i(1-x_i)=tc_i and at most one larger root; strict monotonicity of branch ratios yields unique scalar root. Independent numerical maximization and KKT checks confirmed representative symmetric and asymmetric cost cases, not a universal proof.
